evidence.title: How our agents build on-brand pages with design.md - Vercel

name: How our agents build on-brand pages with design.md
summary: How Vercel built design.md — one public file any coding agent can load to make on-brand pages — and the eval loop behind it.
description: A design-engineering post by John Phamous (31 Aug 2026, 12 min read): why porting Vercel's product-design skill into a public prompt failed because every model interpreted the words differently, how seven fixed eval prompts (renewal proposal, benchmark report, planning page, deck …) turned corrections into rules one at a time, the three-part system of design.md, the published CSS API and a stylesheet that loads in the browser without entering model context, and a build-your-own tutorial.
